name: text_to_speech
description: A text-to-speech tool that converts written text into a spoken wav voice recording using the local Supertonic-3 model with the project's single fixed custom voice (a deep, calm, JARVIS-like male voice that sounds the same in Arabic + English, no cloud). Use whenever the user asks to hear text read aloud or wants a voice message. Saves the wav under X5Agent/Data/files/audio and returns its path plus duration so it plays as a WhatsApp-style voice record inside the chat. Keep text short (one message, max 1000 chars).

voice.description: Fixed project voice (nova). The voice is always the same; any other value is ignored.
